text: dsh-intellisense 帮助用户把 DSH 工具整理成可复用的命名空间和配置 Profile。它提供工具目录与按需搜索，让 agent 在需要时查找工具。用户可在 Web 管理面板中分组工具、编辑别名和说明、排序或停用条目，并管理多套 Profile。插件也提供 Intellisense PTC 模式来组合工具操作。适合需要为编码、研究等任务配置不同工具集的用户。需要兼容的 DSH 环境，无需额外 API Key。

dsh-intellisense organizes DSH tools into reusable Profiles. Agents can discover and search tools on demand. Its web panel supports grouping, alias editing, and Profile management. Intellisense PTC combines tool operations for different tasks. It requires compatible DSH and no extra API key.
想把 DSH 里可用的工具按项目分组，并给它们起简短名称。
能否为不同任务保存不同的工具配置，并在新对话里选择？
我希望 agent 先按需查找工具，而不是一开始看到所有工具细节。
如何编辑工具的别名、说明和分组顺序？
想临时停用某个工具，同时保留它在配置里的位置。
需要查看工具的参数说明和使用次数，应该怎么整理？
I want to organize my DSH tools into reusable profiles for coding and research.
How can an agent discover tools only when it needs them?
dsh-intellisense 的功能「工具命名空间」：用户可将已安装工具放入分组，并为工具和分组设置便于调用的路径别名；命名空间集成负责向 agent 提供目录和发现提示。
dsh-intellisense 的功能「按需搜索工具」：agent 可调用 tools_search，根据当前 Profile 中可见的工具条目查找匹配项，并获得其调用信息。
dsh-intellisense 的功能「可复用工具 Profile」：用户可创建并保存多套工具配置，在不同任务或对话中选择；配置管理代码提供 Profile 会话与持久存储集成。
dsh-intellisense 的功能「管理界面」：插件向 DSH 插件页和对话界面注册管理面板入口，可通过界面组织工具并启动新的整理会话。

@aldveylor/dsh-intellisense README · dsh-intellisense：English | [简体中文](README.zh-cn.md)

dsh-intellisense helps you organize and discover tools in DeepSeek Harness. Group tools, give them clear names and descriptions, and save reusable profiles for different tasks. The agent can look up the tools it needs on demand.

@aldveylor/dsh-intellisense README · Usage：Read the [usage guide](docs/en/usage.md) for tool grouping, agent visibility and interface operations. You can also open it from the plugin configuration page.

@aldveylor/dsh-intellisense README · Installation：**Official DSH Desktop:** Open **Settings → Plugins** in the app, search for `@aldveylor/dsh-intellisense`, and install it through the app's plugin manager. No command line is needed.

**Regular dsh web:** Run this command, then restart dsh web:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @aldveylor/dsh-intellisense
```

**Custom profile:** Replace `web` in that command with your host's actual profile name:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add @aldveylor/dsh-intellisense
```

@aldveylor/dsh-intellisense README · Installation：Follow your host's restart instructions.

The bundle includes **Intellisense Preset** (`intellisense/preset`, entry `@aldveylor/dsh-intellisense/preset`), which registers the Intellisense and Intellisense PTC agent presets. The main component provides namespace services and execution; preset registration is handled separately.

@aldveylor/dsh-intellisense README · Development：Read the [development guide](docs/en/development.md) for agent preset `config.mode` / `config.profile` settings and builtin tool interfaces.

Requires Node.js >=24 and DeepSeek Harness >=0.2.1-rc.2.

@aldveylor/dsh-intellisense README · Install from npm：Start DeepSeek Harness once to initialize the profile you want to use, then stop it. In that profile's directory (the directory containing its `package.json`), run:

```sh
npm install @aldveylor/dsh-intellisense
```

In the same `package.json`, append `"@aldveylor/dsh-intellisense"` to the existing `dsh.profile.bundles` list, keeping the other entries. Restart DeepSeek Harness with that profile.

@aldveylor/dsh-intellisense README · Install from npm：Ctrlernatively, open **Plugins** in the DeepSeek Harness sidebar and install `@aldveylor/dsh-intellisense` from the npm registry, with the bundle enabled. This handles installation and activation for the current profile.

@aldveylor/dsh-intellisense README · Run from source：From the project root, with pnpm installed, run:

```sh
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
./run.sh
```

This starts a separate development profile for trying the plugin locally.

Select an exact DSH version to test against a different host:

```sh
./run.sh --dsh-version 0.2.1-rc.2
node run.mjs --dsh-version 0.2.2-alpha.2
```

@aldveylor/dsh-intellisense README · Run from source：The first run installs that host under `build/dsh_versions/<version>`; later runs reuse it and refresh copies of the local plugins. Each version uses a separate development profile. The project dependencies and lockfile stay unchanged. Both entry points accept `--plugin <directory>` and forward other arguments to DSH; use `--` to end launcher options.
@aldveylor/dsh-intellisense README · Tool management：Read the [usage guide](docs/en/usage.md), also available from the configuration page. Screenshots below use light mode.

@aldveylor/dsh-intellisense README · Namespace management：The namespace tree shows tool groups, call names, and descriptions. Hover a namespace for its name, full path, and notes; hover a command for its summary, full documentation, and call totals. Its original command name opens a second tooltip with tool details. Expand groups, double-click names or comments to edit them, drag sibling entries to reorder them, and set pinned hint levels. Use the controls above the tree to switch, save, or save a copy of a profile for reuse across different tool configurations.

@aldveylor/dsh-intellisense README · Adding tools：Click the tool icon beside “Namespace tree” to open the tool picker. The unmounted count opens a filtered list. Search by name, path, or description, then click an ordinary tool card to add it to the current node. Built-in plugin commands appear as disabled gray cards.

@aldveylor/dsh-intellisense README · Tool details：Hover a card for its original name, description, parameters, return type, and call totals. Parameter types have nested tooltips showing the type expression directly. Table titles sit outside their tables, and columns size to content. Hold Ctrl to keep a tooltip in place, then move into it to scroll manually.
